data.plainLyric:
Let's celebrate
Here lies a broken heart
Rebooting into a new chapter
Seoro dareun chawonui teume neol majuhae
Eojjeomyeon neoneun parts of me i got left
Heundeullineun chotbure
Iksukaetdeon neoneun blur
Now I know your name
Dolgo dora do this again
(Whoo) modeun ge saerowo boyeo
(Whoo) du nun ape gakkawojin geu sungan
You pull me with a strange rush
I'm already in love
Nun gamgo make a wish
Hanadul moin pieces
Neol dalmeun best of me
Now I can see
Cheot majuchim, bwa uriui birthday
Celebrate it, celebrate it, choreul bureo
Celebrate it, celebrate it, choreul bureo
Neol dalmeun best of me
Now I can see
Cheot majuchim, bwa uriui birthday
Me minus you
Neol ppaegoneun heurithaejin chojeomppuniya
Kkumsok deo keojin mulgyeol
Wiro teojin sumgyeol
Saegyeojin forever
Love and cough can't be hidden
My edges are sharp
I know who you are
Hannune neol arabwa nan
You pull me with a strange rush
I'm already in love
Nun gamgo make a wish
Hanadul moin pieces
Neol dalmeun best of me
Now I can see
Cheot majuchim, bwa uriui birthday
Celebrate it, celebrate it, choreul bureo
Celebrate it, celebrate it, choreul bureo
Neol dalmeun best of me
Now I can see
Cheot majuchim, bwa uriui birthday
Neowa nae sesangi
Dallajyeodo yeojeonhi
You'll have the best of me
Itji ankil
Neol wihan gin sowoneul bilge
To long nights and forgotten places
I'd lose my way a thousand times
To find you
Seoro dareun chawonui kkeute neol majuhae
Gieokae neoneun parts of me i got left
Nun gamgo make a wish
Da neoro irwojigil
Wanseongdoen best of me
Now I can breathe
Cheot majuchim, bwa uriui birthday
Celebrate it, celebrate it, choreul bureo (celebrate)
Celebrate it, celebrate it, choreul bureo
Wanseongdoen best of me
Now I can breathe
Yeongwonhi neol tteoollil birthday
